summary: Promotion of an assembled arc to a model edge lands for real in vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/promote.rs (wired by one `pub mod promote;` in kernel/mod.rs; the designed one-line conflict), over the frozen assemble output. promote(arc: &ChainArc, ctx: &PromoContext) -> Result<PromotedEdge, Refusal> walks the eight section 14.3 promotion conditions in order as one refusing entry; every failing condition is a NAMED refusal carrying the evidence. PromotedEdge is a KERNEL RECORD (plain Debug+Clone data, serialization not booked, deliberately NOT a live truck_topology::Edge handle - the record avoids the circle-carried self-loop class the landed topology constructors panic on in debug). Record fields: the model-space Hermite approximant gamma, both pcurves in their lifted charts, the exported arclength parameterization with its position table (condition 7), knot multiplicities set at crossings and cusps (condition 6), and the owning-face chart ids; the record ends fuse the chain ends with the shared C1 nodes they resolve to. Conditions: (1) run/deck ceiling - single-chart run, finite/canonical stored ends, positive developed run, approx endpoints matching the chain ends, and |deck| inside a promoted arc at or below the landed config DECK_MAX (Refused(DeckExhausted), backing Inconclusive - the spec termination bound holds at promotion even though deck_identify already refuses at assembly); (2) endpoint identity by the LANDED A4.2 rules (assemble's regions_identify reused, never re-derived, with identity's rule_b_transport across deck copies) - near ends (within the representation gap) must certify as one shared C1 node, and a near pair no rule identifies is Refused(SliverOrNearOverlap) carrying both endpoints verbatim (never snap); (3) trim events in one chart route through the landed R9 residual (a Crossing interior event not R9-certified is refused); (4) interior events finite, C1-certified, strictly inside and ordered in the developed run; (5) endpoint C1 certificates (stored endpoint regions and shared end node certificates within the RHO_MAX ceiling); (6) knot multiplicity set from the certified class (transversal crossing 2, A2 cusp 3); (7) exported arclength position table over the approximant vertices (zero-total-length edge refused); (8) the TangencyAtTolerance gate - an end node carrying the section 10.3 rule-7 tag (NodeCert::AtTolerance) refuses UNLESS PromoContext carries the explicit typed opt-in (TangencyOptIn enum, not a bool default true). The context supplies the assembled-arc data a ChainArc data statement deliberately does not restate: period, section 4.2 union certificates, approx, owning-face charts, shared end nodes, certified interior events. House rules hold: neither new file contains unwrap/expect/panic and neither adds a module-level allow (result_large_err allowed item-level only with the standard frozen-shape comment, matching every other kernel module); H-3 markers sit on the fixture float-literal lines in the test file. Fixtures are built from the frozen kit's shapes (fx::deck_wrap period/params) and extend nothing. No stop condition fired: the frozen seam (ChainArc/ChainEnd shape, A4.2 regions_identify entries, config::DECK_MAX/EPS_REP/RHO_MAX) matched what the packet names; every condition is checked from stored data alone reusing the landed seams (regions_identify, rule_b_transport, ResidualId::R9, the config constants) - no numeric solve outside the landed seams was needed; no A4.2 rule had to be replaced by Euclidean welding.

design_decisions_recorded.promoted_edge_is_a_record: PromotedEdge is plain data (Debug + Clone + PartialEq), serialization not booked for this wave; the record deliberately is NOT a live truck_topology::Edge handle - the landed topology constructors panic in debug on circle-carried self-loops, and the record (whose closed full-wrap fixture ends on one shared C1 node) avoids the whole class. Binding to live handles is downstream integration, not this packet.
design_decisions_recorded.promo_context_carries_the_assembled_data: A ChainArc is a section 14.2 data statement of the arc's two certified chart ends only (frozen shape). The context therefore supplies the assembled-arc data the record restates and the conditions consume: the chart period, the section 4.2 union certificates, the model-space Hermite approximant (whose stored ends must equal the chain ends), the two owning-face chart ids, the shared C1 node each end resolves to (kind + NodeCert; NodeCert::AtTolerance is the section 10.3 tangency tag), and the certified interior events.
design_decisions_recorded.condition_8_flag_is_typed: The condition-8 opt-in is a typed field `admit_tangent_at_tolerance: TangencyOptIn` (enum Admit/Refuse), deliberately not a bool default true - promote never assumes an at-tolerance endpoint is admitted; the tagged-endpoint refusal names the predicate promote_tangency_at_tolerance_requires_opt_in.
design_decisions_recorded.sliver_never_snap: The SliverOrNearOverlap refusal is a named predicate refusal (sliver_near_overlap_refuses_never_snap) whose detail carries BOTH endpoints verbatim (full ChainEnd debug) - the test asserts no coordinate was moved and no midpoint was invented.
design_decisions_recorded.knot_multiplicity_table: Interior Crossing events get knot multiplicity 2 (two 1-complex branches join transversally in the chart) and Cusp events get 3 (the A2 cusp degenerates the tangent); the class table is total and recorded as condition 6.
design_decisions_recorded.trim_events_via_r9: Condition 3 requires every interior Crossing event certificate to carry the landed one-chart R9 residual (ResidualId::R9, residuals_r89's curve-curve family); a Crossing certified at any other residual refuses as promote_trim_crossing_not_r9_certified.
